name: triago
description: Email-to-ticket triage for support teams: AI drafts, humans decide.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
